body:
Frontend (F1–F4) added on top of the engine + API:

- **F1 Horizon & Network** — tag base/horizon model years + SANDAG file.
- **F2 Network Match** — pull `/forecast/ingest-match`, focused Leaflet map colored by leg status, per-leg confirm/override/skip, gate on unresolved legs.
- **F3 Run Forecast** — Ratio-default (Difference/Combined gated on a peak-hour factor K, with inline copy explaining why), `/forecast/run`, per-period diagnostics.
- **F4 Future Results** — future TMC table, existing-vs-future comparison diagrams (reusing `/intersection-diagram`), persistent NCHRP 765 citation chip → click-to-expand provenance.
- Signal palette (amber forecasting / green existing / red reserved) + charcoal dark base; gated amber sidebar group; `Continue to Forecasting →` CTA on S8.

eslint clean, `vite build` passes. Backend tests stay green (the path fix is covered).

**Known limits:** real forecast needs the 2030 SANDAG network (today: identity-growth dry-run by tagging one file as both base+horizon). Run the app under the combined venv for the geo-dependent ingest.

Closing without merging. The same QC-08 corridor-order fix shipped to the live app's QC path (balancer.py) in #4, now merged to main. This PR fixed the removed legacy monolith (3_demand_analysis.py) as a parallel record; with #4 merged it's redundant. Branches deleted — commits remain recoverable from this closed PR if ever needed.
Already in main: both commits (c5255f8, f615f55) landed with #15/#18, so nothing left to merge.
Superseded: #21 merged directly and #16 was already in main; everything else landed in #23.
Closing: its only included PR, #24, was merged directly at the same head (3489872).

**Full Examiner harness, same 200 corridors before and after (seeds 1-50 per tier, real API path):**

- Tier A: 50/50 pass before, 50/50 after
- Tier B: 49 pass + 1 marginal before, same after (same seed, unchanged)
- Tier C: 44 pass + 6 marginal before, 50/50 pass after
- Tier D: 40 pass + 10 marginal before, 50/50 pass after (worst GEH 8.0 -> 5.0)

No corridor got worse. No FAIL before or after in this range.

Owner answer (2026-11-10): "1 yes to leave"

- OPEN 1: keep, side-street legs with no link float.
- OPEN 2: leave the "larger" link rule as is.

Recorded as DECIDED in `Docs/through-inflation-fix.md`.
